symptom: A technical delivery could end with pending gates or a next-action list, leaving the user to ask what happens next even though the remaining steps were autonomously executable.
root_cause: The no-pending-output contract prohibited non-terminal labels but did not make dashboard/current-state registration and fixed terminal user handoff explicit terminal gates.
A production Supabase migration could be applied under a provider-assigned timestamp different from the repository filename, causing terminal migration-ledger identity readback to fail after merge.
fix: Require autonomous ownership through merge, production/provider readback, outcome, learning/prevention, skill projection, documentation, Powerhouse dashboard/current-state registration, activity ledger and read-after-write.
Reconcile repository migration identity to the production Supabase migration ledger before terminal closure.
prevention: Never give the user an autonomous what-now list as the final response.
Only BLOCKED_HARD_BOUNDARY may transfer one smallest necessary human action.
Dashboard/current-state writeback and read-after-write are mandatory terminal evidence.
Migration filename/version identity must match the production migration ledger, not merely SQL content.
